items.headline: Man arrested after lunging at Ohio candidate for governor
items.detail: A man was arrested after lunging at Ohio’s Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton. Witnesses say he pushed his way through a crowd holding a cell phone. Her security detail prevented him from reaching her.

items.headline: Gas prices reach Labor Day high amid Iran war
items.detail: The average price of gas going into this Labor Day weekend reached a record holiday high compared to past years at $4.14 a gallon, according to a national tracking average from AAA. The previous record for Labor Day was $3.82 in 2012.

items.headline: Worker injured during White House construction rescued by emergency crew
items.detail: An emergency crew rescued a construction worker from high up in scaffolding on the White House North Portico on Monday afternoon, responding to a dispatch saying that a worker had been injured.

items.headline: Hunter Biden to launch crypto meme coin
items.detail: Hunter Biden, son of former President Joe Biden, announced Monday that he’s debuting a meme coin, traded under the ticker $LAPTOP, in reference to the political controversy that swarmed him in 2020 and since over his personal laptop.

items.headline: Rudy Giuliani urges Mamdani to not attend 9/11 anniversary
items.detail: Rudy Giuliani, the former mayor of New York City who later worked as President Trump’s personal lawyer, publicly criticized current Mayor Zohran Mamdani for planning to attend a 9/11 commemoration ceremony at Ground Zero on Friday.

items.headline: Trump posts updates about his DC ‘beautification’ projects
